summary: Runtime dispatched all 4 checks but each returned exit_code=101 in under 350ms — far too fast to be cargo failures. Root cause: cwdRef "." resolved to changeDir (docs/comet/changes/pi-rs-modularization-phase1) rather than workspace root, so `cargo` ran with no Cargo.toml and bailed instantly. Same checks pass when run locally from the workspace root (verified this turn: A1 1m22s cold / 0.31s warm, A3 4/4 in 1.57s, A4 1m37s green for new crates, A6 6m16s cold). All Phase-1 acceptance criteria for the new crates are green on this host; the failure is in the Runtime check execution path, not in the candidate.
